examples.code:
# Create a Merge node using the standard over operation.
merge = nuke.createNode("Merge2")
merge["operation"].setValue("over")
examples.title: Create an Over merge

examples.code:
# Change an existing Merge node to Plus.
merge = nuke.createNode("Merge2")
merge["operation"].setValue("plus")
examples.title: Change the merge operation

examples.code:
# Merge RGB channels while leaving other channels unchanged.
merge = nuke.createNode("Merge2")
merge["Achannels"].setValue("rgb")
merge["Bchannels"].setValue("rgb")
examples.title: Restrict the merge channels
